Every host under sources[] is automatically excluded from extraction along with its subdomains, so a report's own navigation, footer and author links never become indicators. Each source carries the DPRK activity cluster it reports on (campaign), applied to every indicator drawn from it. not_scraped[] records URLs already evaluated and rejected, with the reason, so a future review does not re-check them.
